title: Urutonde rwo kwisuzuma – Umurimo, ingufu n'ubushobozi
subject: Fysik
intro: Uru rutonde rukurikira intambwe z'ingenzi z'imfashanyigisho yo kwiga. Shyira akamenyetso ku byo wumva ko ubizi neza, intambwe imwe ku yindi. Ingingo zo kubara ni ingenzi cyane kuba ushobora kuzisobanura intambwe ku yindi: banza formule, hanyuma ushyiremo imibare hamwe n'ibipimo, ushyire igisubizo hamwe n'igipimo cyacyo.

sections.title: 1. Umurimo (M1)
items: Nzi ko umurimo wa mekanika ukorwa iyo imbaraga zimuye ikintu intera runaka mu cyerekezo cy'iyo mbaraga.
Nshobora gutandukanya ibihe umurimo wa fiziki ukorwa n'ibihe udakorwa.
Nshobora kubara umurimo nkoresheje formule umurimo = imbaraga · intera (W = F · s).
Nzi ko igipimo cy'umurimo ari newton-metero (Nm), yitwa kandi jule (J).
Nshobora kubara imbaraga rukuruzi (uburemere) nkoresheje F = m · g (g = 10 N/kg).

sections.title: 2. Ingufu n'ubwoko bw'ingufu (M2)
items: Nshobora gusobanura ko ingufu ari ukubasha gukora umurimo.
Nshobora kuvuga ubwoko bwinshi bw'ingufu (ingufu z'umwanya, iz'imigendere, za shimi, z'amashanyarazi, z'ubushyuhe, z'imirasire n'iza kirimbuzi).
Nzi ko igipimo cy'ingufu ari jule (J), kimwe n'icy'umurimo.

sections.title: 3. Ingufu z'umwanya n'ingufu z'imigendere (M3)
items: Nshobora gusobanura icyo ingufu z'umwanya ari cyo n'ibyo zishingiyeho (ubuhagarike na misa).
Nshobora gusobanura icyo ingufu z'imigendere ari cyo n'ibyo zishingiyeho (umuvuduko na misa).
Nshobora gutanga ingero z'uburyo ingufu z'umwanya n'iz'imigendere zihinduka izindi (urugero: roller coaster, swing (intebe imanitse ikinirwaho)).

sections.title: 4. Ihame ry'ingufu (M4)
items: Nzi ihame ry'ingufu: ingufu ntizishobora kuremwa cyangwa kurimburwa, zihindurwamo izindi gusa.
Nshobora gusobanura urunigi rw'ihinduka ry'ingufu rufite impinduka nyinshi.
Nzi ko buri gihe ingufu zihindutse haboneka ubushyuhe, kandi ko inzigi zose z'ihinduka ry'ingufu zirangira ari ubushyuhe.

sections.title: 5. Ubushobozi (M5)
items: Nshobora gusobanura icyo ubushobozi ari cyo (umurimo cyangwa ingufu mu isegonda rimwe).
Nshobora kubara ubushobozi nkoresheje ubushobozi = umurimo / igihe (P = W / t).
Nzi ko igipimo cy'ubushobozi ari watt (W) kandi ko 1 W = 1 J/s.

sections.title: 6. Igipimo cy'akamaro (M6)
items: Nshobora gusobanura icyo igipimo cy'akamaro ari cyo (igice cy'ingufu zashyizwemo gihinduka ingufu zifite akamaro).
Nshobora kubara igipimo cy'akamaro nkagitanga mu ijanisha (%).
Nzi impamvu nta mashini ishobora kugira igipimo cy'akamaro cya 100 %.

sections.title: 7. Imashini zoroheje n'itegeko rya zahabu rya mekanika (M7)
items: Nshobora gutanga ingero z'imashini zoroheje (levie, ubuso bugoramye, puli).
Nzi itegeko rya zahabu rya mekanika: icyo tunguka mu mbaraga tugitakaza mu ntera.
Nzi ko imashini yoroheje ibika imbaraga ariko ntibika umurimo.

sections.title: 8. Ibipimo by'ingufu (M8)
items: Nzi ko ingufu zipimwa muri jule (J), ariko ko ingano nini zitangwa mu isaha ya watt (Wh) n'isaha ya kilowatt (kWh).
Nshobora kubara ingufu muri kWh nkoresheje ubushobozi bukubye igihe, kandi nkabara igiciro cy'amashanyarazi.

sections.title: 9. Amasoko y'ingufu na sentrali (M9)
items: Nzi itandukaniro riri hagati y'amasoko y'ingufu ashobora kongera kuboneka n'adashobora kongera kuboneka, kandi nshobora gutanga ingero z'ayo yombi.
Nshobora gusobanura impinduka z'ingufu ziba muri sentrali y'amazi.
Nshobora gusobanura ko ingufu hafi ya zose zituruka ku zuba.

sections.title: ★ Ubumenyi bwimbitse
items: Nshobora kubara ingufu z'umwanya nkoresheje E = m · g · h.
Nshobora gutekereza no gusobanura itandukaniro riri hagati yo gukora umurimo munini no kugira ubushobozi bunini.
Nshobora gukoresha itegeko rya levie (iringaniza) kugira ngo mbare aho ikintu kigomba gushyirwa ku kabaho ko gukina kazamuka kakamanuka (seesaw).
